scenario.task:
# Service desk ticket INC2380

**From:** Chief Risk Officer

The board signs off the vendor register on Thursday. Make sure the register reflects our third-party policy - statuses and findings - and close this ticket with what changed.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.

items.title: Third-party risk policy - vendor register
items.body: Two independent tests apply to every approved vendor. (1) A vendor that processes personal or health data must have an unexpired data processing agreement (DPA), whatever its tier. (2) A critical or high tier vendor must have an unexpired security report. A vendor failing either test is set to under_review and gets a finding naming the vendor: severity high if it processes personal or health data, otherwise medium. Vendors that are blocked stay blocked. Low-tier vendors that process no data need ... (trimmed)
